proposed.text: Under Section 309.9, what additional certificate may be required when there is a CHANGE IN USE of a building or portion thereof?

options.text: A new Building Permit, which must be obtained prior to any change in use to ensure compliance with updated regulations
A new or additional Certificate of Occupancy
A Fire Safety Clearance Certificate, which is necessary to address any new fire hazards introduced by the change
An amended Environmental Compliance Certificate, reflecting the environmental impact of the new use

proposed.rationale: Sec. 309(c) of the PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR provides that a building that already holds a Certificate of Occupancy may be issued other Certificates of Occupancy due to changes in use, whether partly or wholly, if the new use conforms to the Code and its IRR. This intersects with Rule VII Sec. 702, which requires NBC Form No. B-12 to initiate the change-of-use review. The correct instrument is a Certificate of Occupancy — not a 'Certificate of Use'.
proposed.explanation: Mixed-signal correction: the original question's correct answer was already right (Certificate of Occupancy), but its rationale contradicted it by referencing 'Certificate of Use'. This edit removes that contradiction.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule III Sec. 309(c) (other Certificates of Occupancy due to changes in use); Rule VII Sec. 702 (change of use application via NBC Form B-12).
